captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a cross-slide milling vise with a dark grey rectangular base. It features two sliding jaw assemblies: a lower slide that translates along the transverse X-axis, and a secondary upper slide that moves perpendicularly along the Y-axis. The jaws themselves are light grey rectangular plates, and two black handwheels with central hexagonal nuts are mounted on the sides to control the sliding adjustments.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a cross-slide milling vise. It should have a dark grey rectangular base block, a lower slide moving on a transverse prismatic joint, and an upper slide moving on a perpendicular prismatic joint. Include light grey rectangular clamping jaws and two black handwheels with hexagonal center bolts to control the movements.
captions.factory: The code constructs an ArticulatedObject by first defining a base link from a rectangular Box. It then creates a lower slide and an upper slide using Box primitives, adding light grey jaw plates. Two handwheels are modeled using Cylinder primitives for the outer ring, hub, and spokes, capped with a hexagonal prism for the bolt. Prismatic articulations are defined to link the base to the lower slide, and the lower slide to the upper slide, while revolute articulations connect the handwheels to their respective slides.
